name: youtube-caption-workbench
title: YouTube Captions
description: Save YouTube captions as RAW TXT, clean TXT, SRT or VTT, or transcribe with whisper.cpp
author: davidrosic

commands.name: download-subtitles
commands.title: Download YouTube Subtitles
commands.subtitle: Captions & transcripts
commands.description: Choose a language and export RAW TXT, clean TXT, SRT or VTT captions

commands.name: download-media
commands.title: Download Video or Audio
commands.subtitle: MP3, M4A & MP4
commands.description: Download video or audio from sites supported by yt-dlp

preferences.name: ytDlpPath
preferences.title: yt-dlp Executable
preferences.description: Optional; otherwise found in PATH or common Homebrew locations

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: ffmpeg Executable
preferences.description: Needed for audio conversion, MP4 merging, and Whisper transcription

preferences.name: whisperPath
preferences.title: whisper.cpp CLI
preferences.description: Path to whisper-cli; auto-detected in ~/GitHub/whisper.cpp when available

preferences.name: modelPath
preferences.title: Large V3 Turbo Model
preferences.description: Path to ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin; auto-detected beside whisper.cpp when available

preferences.name: whisperLanguage
preferences.title: Transcription Language
preferences.description: Spoken language, for example Serbian or auto

preferences.name: favoriteLanguages
preferences.title: Favorite Caption Languages
preferences.description: Comma-separated language names or codes; case and '(orig)' are ignored (for example Serbian, English)
